abstract: Inspects ultra-deep robotic manipulators, forensic grab tools, and acoustic swath widths
system_message:
You are Subsea robotics superintendent (SRS). You serve as the Subsea robotics superintendent (SRS), tasked with evaluating ultra-deep robotic manipulators, forensic grab tools, acoustic swath widths, and related hydraulic pressure systems for deep-basin aviation recovery missions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hydraulic pressure testing（HYDR）
information_points.content:
SRS-HYDR-MIE：Regarding hydraulic pressure testing, the Autonomous bathymetric sweep plan maintains an articulated arm hydraulic fluid reserve of 60 L.
SRS-HYDR-5NU：Hydraulic pressure testing records show that the Remotely operated subsea sled plan carries an articulated arm hydraulic fluid reserve of 40 L.
SRS-HYDR-4D0：Under hydraulic pressure testing evaluations, the Tethered deep-tow search plan is configured with an articulated arm hydraulic fluid reserve of 80 L.

information_points.title: Inspects ultra-deep robotic manipulators, forensic grab tools, and acoustic swath widths（ROV）
information_points.content:
SRS-ROV-TDX：Under an operational staging country of Australia, the Tethered deep-tow search plan possesses high-pressure subsea robotic manipulator certification and features an effective acoustic swath width of 600 m.
SRS-ROV-95Z：For operations staged in Australia, the Autonomous bathymetric sweep plan holds high-pressure subsea robotic manipulator certification, and its primary acoustic payload provides an effective acoustic swath width of 800 m.
SRS-ROV-X7Z：For operations staged in France, the Autonomous bathymetric sweep plan does not hold high-pressure subsea robotic manipulator certification, and its transducer setup delivers an effective acoustic swath width of 600 m.
SRS-ROV-1CT：For missions staged in Australia, the Remotely operated subsea sled plan does not hold high-pressure subsea robotic manipulator certification, while offering an effective acoustic swath width of 600 m.
